definitions.explanation: Plants that grow in or on water — in rivers, lakes, ponds, or aquariums. Includes both fully submerged plants and ones whose leaves float on the surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{水草|みずくさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えている→生える：02392_haeru⟧。
examples.english: Aquatic plants are growing in the pond.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{水草|みずくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: Putting water plants in the tank helps the fish settle.

examples.japanese: {水草|みずくさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧し、⟦{水質|すいしつ}→水質：22420_suishitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: Water plants supply oxygen and also play a role in maintaining water quality.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) + ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass, plant). A general term covering anything from pond weeds to ornamental aquarium plants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水草|みずくさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: water plants grow
- {水草|みずくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧: to plant water plants
- {水草|みずくさ}⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧: planted aquarium

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水|みず}{生|せい}⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧: aquatic plant — technical/scientific term
- ⟦{藻|も}→藻：14821_mo⟧: algae; seaweed — generally simpler organisms than {水草|みずくさ}
- ⟦{海藻|かいそう}→海藻：06750_kaisou⟧: seaweed — specifically marine, not freshwater
